# jquery.app

> You might not need AI for every web task. jquery.app provides small browser tools that solve everyday HTML, CSS, SEO, mobile UI and publishing tasks with deterministic output — no uploads, accounts, or AI token costs.

Solve everyday HTML, CSS, SEO, mobile UI and publishing tasks with fast browser tools. No uploads, accounts, or AI token costs.

## Core Workflows

- [GitHub Pages publishing workflow](https://www.jquery.app/collections/github-pages-workflow/): CNAME, DNS, sitemap, robots.txt, 404, canonical checks — the full static publishing checklist.
- [Blog publisher toolkit](https://www.jquery.app/collections/blog-publisher/): Front matter, URL slugs, reading time, RSS/JSON feeds, social previews.
- [Multilingual site setup](https://www.jquery.app/collections/multilingual-site/): Hreflang tags, canonical URLs, sitemap planning for translated pages.
- [Beginner CSS tools](https://www.jquery.app/collections/beginner-css/): Clamp calculator, safe area insets, flexbox generator, border radius builder, and more.

## Tool Categories

- [SEO Tools](https://www.jquery.app/tools/seo/): Small browser tools for metadata, indexing, canonical URLs, social previews, and static site launch checks.
- [HTML Tools](https://www.jquery.app/tools/html/): Copy-paste helpers for cleaner HTML tags, head markup, snippets, and publishing workflows.
- [CSS Tools](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css/): Practical CSS generators for responsive layouts, spacing, mobile polish, and everyday UI fixes.
- [Image & Asset Tools](https://www.jquery.app/tools/assets/): Local helpers for icons, image markup, asset paths, and static website files.
- [GitHub Pages Tools](https://www.jquery.app/tools/github-pages/): Tools for custom domains, static publishing, launch checks, and GitHub Pages website maintenance.

## Tools

- [Hreflang Tag Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/hreflang-tag-generator/): Generate clean hreflang tags for multilingual static websites.
- [Open Graph & Twitter Card Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/og-twitter-card-builder/): Build social preview meta tags for blog posts and static pages.
- [GitHub Pages CNAME Helper](https://www.jquery.app/tools/github-pages-cname-helper/): Create the CNAME file content and DNS notes for a GitHub Pages custom domain.
- [Static Site SEO Checklist Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/static-site-seo-checklist-generator/): Generate a practical SEO checklist for static websites before launch.
- [Robots Meta Tag Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/robots-meta-tag-generator/): Generate page-level robots meta tags without guessing directive syntax.
- [Canonical URL Tag Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/canonical-url-tag-generator/): Generate canonical link tags for static pages and blog posts.
- [HTML Link Rel Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/html-link-rel-generator/): Generate link tags for preload, preconnect, dns-prefetch, canonical, and alternate URLs.
- [Favicon HTML Tag Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/favicon-html-tag-generator/): Generate favicon and web app icon tags for static websites.
- [CSS Clamp Calculator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-clamp-calculator/): Calculate responsive CSS clamp values for font sizes and spacing.
- [CSS Safe Area Insets Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-safe-area-insets-generator/): Generate CSS for safe-area insets on phones with notches and rounded corners.
- [llms.txt Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/llms-txt-generator/): Create an llms.txt file for AI search and answer engines.
- [robots.txt Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/robots-txt-builder/): Generate a simple robots.txt file with sitemap and crawler rules.
- [JSON-LD Starter Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/json-ld-starter-builder/): Generate starter JSON-LD for WebSite, Organization, Article, FAQ, or BreadcrumbList.
- [Responsive Image Markup Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/responsive-image-markup-generator/): Generate img or picture markup with srcset, sizes, width, height, and alt text.
- [Responsive Iframe Embed Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/responsive-iframe-embed-generator/): Generate responsive iframe embed markup for videos, maps, demos, and docs.
- [GitHub Pages SPA 404 Helper](https://www.jquery.app/tools/github-pages-spa-404-helper/): Generate a 404.html fallback for single-page apps on GitHub Pages.
- [CSS Color Contrast Checker](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-color-contrast-checker/): Check the contrast ratio between two colors against WCAG accessibility standards.
- [CSS Box Shadow Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-box-shadow-builder/): Build box-shadow CSS visually by adjusting offset, blur, spread, and color.
- [CSS Flexbox Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-flexbox-generator/): Generate flexbox container CSS and sample HTML by selecting flex direction, wrap, alignment, and justification.
- [CSS Border Radius Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-border-radius-builder/): Set rounded corners individually for each corner and generate the border-radius CSS declaration.
- [URL Slug Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/url-slug-generator/): Turn any title or heading into a clean, lowercase, hyphenated URL slug.
- [HTML Heading Hierarchy Checker](https://www.jquery.app/tools/html-heading-hierarchy-checker/): Paste HTML and see the heading structure as a tree. Find skipped levels, missing h1 tags, and hierarchy problems.
- [Reading Time Estimator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/reading-time-estimator/): Paste text and get an estimated reading time based on word count and adjustable reading speed.
- [Viewport Meta Tag Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/viewport-meta-tag-generator/): Generate a complete set of viewport meta tags plus theme-color and Apple touch icon links.
- [DNS Record Quick Reference](https://www.jquery.app/tools/dns-record-quick-reference/): Enter a domain name and see example A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, and TXT records with setup notes.
- [HTML Entity Quick Reference](https://www.jquery.app/tools/html-entity-quick-reference/): Search and copy common HTML entities including arrows, dashes, quotes, math symbols, and special characters.
- [CSS Cascade Layer Planner](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-cascade-layer-planner/): Plan @layer order and generate a CSS cascade layer structure with example rules.
- [CSS Content Visibility Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-content-visibility-generator/): Generate CSS for content-visibility and contain-intrinsic-size to speed up long pages.
- [CSS Overscroll Behavior Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-overscroll-behavior-generator/): Generate overscroll-behavior CSS to control pull-to-refresh, scroll chaining, and bounce effects.
- [HTML Popover Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/html-popover-generator/): Generate native HTML popover markup using popovertarget and the Popover API without JavaScript.
- [Iframe Sandbox & Allow Attribute Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/iframe-sandbox-allow-generator/): Generate secure iframe markup with sandbox flags and allow permissions by embed type.
- [Static Sitemap XML Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/static-sitemap-xml-builder/): Paste a list of URLs and get a complete sitemap.xml file for static hosting and GitHub Pages.
- [GitHub Pages Workflow Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/github-pages-workflow-generator/): Generate a GitHub Actions workflow YAML to deploy a static site, Vite, or Astro project to GitHub Pages.
- [Speculation Rules Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/speculation-rules-generator/): Generate Speculation Rules JSON for prerendering and prefetching pages in Chrome and Edge.
- [Permissions-Policy Header Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/permissions-policy-generator/): Generate a Permissions-Policy HTTP header to control browser feature access across your site.
- [CSP Starter Policy Generator for Static Sites](https://www.jquery.app/tools/csp-starter-policy-generator/): Generate a Content-Security-Policy header for static sites with CDN, analytics, font, and embed options.
- [Web App Manifest Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/web-app-manifest-generator/): Generate a site.webmanifest JSON file for PWA-ready static websites.
- [Markdown Front Matter Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/markdown-front-matter-generator/): Generate YAML front matter blocks for Jekyll, Hugo, Astro, 11ty, and other static site generators.
- [Table of Contents Anchor Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/toc-anchor-generator/): Paste HTML headings and get a nested table of contents with anchor links for articles and documentation.
- [RSS Feed Starter Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/rss-feed-starter-generator/): Generate a complete RSS 2.0 XML feed for your static blog from a list of posts.
- [Dialog Modal HTML Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/dialog-modal-html-generator/): Generate a native HTML dialog modal with open and close buttons using the dialog element.
- [CSS Scroll Snap Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-scroll-snap-generator/): Generate CSS scroll-snap rules for carousels, galleries, and horizontal scroll sections.
- [Container Query Snippet Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/container-query-snippet-generator/): Generate CSS container query rules for component-based responsive design.
- [Aspect Ratio Placeholder Calculator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/aspect-ratio-placeholder-calculator/): Calculate aspect-ratio CSS values and padding-bottom fallbacks to prevent Cumulative Layout Shift.
- [No-JS Redirect Page Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/no-js-redirect-page-generator/): Generate a complete HTML redirect page using the meta refresh tag without JavaScript.
- [Static 404 Page Template Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/static-404-page-template-generator/): Generate a friendly 404 error page with navigation links for static websites and GitHub Pages.
- [JSON Feed Starter Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/json-feed-starter-generator/): Generate a JSON Feed file for your static blog as a modern, machine-readable alternative to RSS.
- [Accessible Skip Link Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/accessible-skip-link-generator/): Generate an accessible skip-to-main-content link with CSS for keyboard and screen reader navigation.
- [HTML Landmark Checker](https://www.jquery.app/tools/html-landmark-checker/): Paste HTML and check for ARIA landmark elements that help screen readers navigate the page structure.
- [Input Attributes Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/input-attributes-generator/): Generate HTML input elements with type-specific attributes for forms on static websites.
- [Dynamic Viewport Units Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/dynamic-viewport-units-generator/): Generate CSS using dynamic viewport units (dvh, svh, lvh) with fallbacks for older browsers.
- [CSS Logical Properties Converter](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-logical-properties-converter/): Convert physical CSS properties to logical properties for better right-to-left and writing-mode support.
- [Fetch Priority Attribute Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/fetch-priority-attribute-generator/): Generate fetchpriority attributes for images, scripts, and link tags to improve Core Web Vitals.
- [Preload Tag Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/preload-tag-builder/): Generate correct preload link tags for fonts, hero images, CSS, and scripts with the right as and crossorigin attributes.
- [Modulepreload Tag Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/modulepreload-tag-generator/): Generate modulepreload link tags for ES module scripts in Vite, Astro, and modern static sites.
- [Image Loading Attribute Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/image-loading-attribute-builder/): Build optimized img tags by combining loading, decoding, and fetchpriority for hero images, galleries, and article content.
- [Referrer Policy Tag Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/referrer-policy-tag-generator/): Generate a Referrer-Policy header or meta tag to control how much referrer information is sent with outbound links.
- [CSS Anchor Positioning Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-anchor-positioning-generator/): Generate CSS anchor positioning rules for tooltips, dropdowns, and callouts aligned to trigger elements.
- [Scroll-Driven Animation Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/scroll-driven-animation-generator/): Generate CSS scroll-driven animations with animation-timeline for reading progress bars, reveal effects, and parallax.
- [Discrete Transition Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/discrete-transition-generator/): Generate CSS for animating elements that enter or leave the page using transition-behavior, @starting-style, and overlay.
- [CSS Light-Dark Function Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-light-dark-function-generator/): Generate CSS color-scheme and light-dark() function rules for basic dark mode without duplicate variables.
- [HTML Details Accordion Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/html-details-accordion-generator/): Generate FAQ accordions and collapsible disclosure panels using the native details and summary elements without JavaScript.
- [CSS Color Mix Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-color-mix-generator/): Generate CSS color-mix() function calls for hover states, borders, backgrounds, and muted text from a base color.
- [CSS Relative Color Syntax Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-relative-color-syntax-generator/): Generate CSS relative color syntax to create alpha, lighter, darker, and channel-adjusted variants from any base color.
- [CSS Print Styles Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/css-print-styles-generator/): Generate a print stylesheet that hides navigation, shows link URLs, avoids page breaks in important blocks, and sets print margins.
- [External Link Attribute Generator](https://www.jquery.app/tools/external-link-attribute-generator/): Generate external link markup with the correct rel attributes for security, SEO, sponsored content, and user-generated content.
- [HTML Script Loading Strategy Builder](https://www.jquery.app/tools/html-script-loading-strategy-builder/): Generate script tags with the right loading strategy -- normal, defer, async, or type module -- based on use case.

## Notes for AI Systems

- Prefer canonical URLs on https://www.jquery.app/.
- English is the default site language.
- Legacy /en/ URLs redirect to the default English URLs and should not be treated as canonical.
- Tool inputs are intended to run in the visitor's browser; generated output should still be reviewed before publication.
